tns:patch.keyword: Increase imported_project_name column length to support long project names
tns:patch.author: brianbrix
tns:patch.description: Increases the IMPORTED_PROJECT_CURRENCY.imported_project_name column from varchar(255) to varchar(2000) to accommodate lengthy project names that may exceed 255 characters.

script.lang: -- Increase imported_project_name column length from 255 to 2000 characters ALTER TABLE IMPORTED_PROJECT_CURRENCY ALTER COLUMN imported_project_name TYPE varchar(2000);
